sources.locator: AFIPS 1967 bibliographic record, abstract and serial-fraction argument
sources.boundary: Amdahl supplies a theoretical fixed-work boundary, not a root-cause diagnosis for a modern MPP engine.

sources.locator: CACM 1988 paper argument for scaled problems and scaled speedup
sources.boundary: Scaled speedup answers a capacity question and does not replace fixed-work strong scaling.

sources.locator: ICDE paper sections on coordinator, stages, tasks, splits, exchanges and execution
sources.boundary: The paper provides a system model; actual scaling and storage behavior require versioned runtime counters.

sources.locator: Official EXPLAIN and distributed execution documentation
sources.boundary: Plan structure and estimates are not runtime observations.

sources.locator: Official cost-based optimization and join distribution documentation
sources.boundary: Broadcast and partitioned behavior, caps and defaults are version-sensitive and statistics-dependent.

sources.locator: Official spill lifecycle, memory, disk, operator support and legacy-warning documentation
sources.boundary: Spill can reduce peak memory for supported cases but cannot guarantee completion or a fixed slowdown factor.

sources.locator: SIGMOD 2016 Sections 2-3 on shared-nothing, shared-data architecture, virtual warehouses and local cache
sources.boundary: The paper describes a 2016 system design and does not define all modern separated-storage services.

sources.locator: Official WLM metric definitions for queue, execution, CPU, temp blocks and skew
sources.boundary: Field names and clock boundaries are Redshift contracts, not universal engine terminology.

sources.locator: Official eligibility, routing, monitoring and usage documentation
sources.boundary: Extra capacity only applies to eligible work and has configuration, startup and cost boundaries.

sources.locator: FinOps Framework guidance on data-cloud allocation, TCO, unit economics and workload telemetry
sources.boundary: The framework provides cost categories and governance, not one vendor-neutral rate formula.

sources.locator: FinOps capability definition for technical and business unit metrics
sources.boundary: A technical unit cost does not by itself establish business value.

sources.locator: Official on-demand bytes-processed, capacity slots, storage and transfer pricing categories
sources.boundary: Rates, minimums, editions, regions, commitments and transfer rules must be snapshotted at decision time.
